19ae415e.text:
$N, you've got a good sword arm and I've taken notice. 

Things are a fine mess here on Zephras Isle, no doubt about it. We need our fighting shen'dorei in top form if we are to survive what's to come. It's time for you to stop playing at being a proper $c, and actually become one.

Find me inside the base of the watchtower here in Thendal Village. I'll see to it you are properly trained.


-Blademaster Ren, $C Trainer
19ae415e.title: Crumpled Note

6491|22357dc5.name: Spirit Healer
6491|22357dc5.text: It is not yet your time. I shall aid your journey back to the realm of the living... for a price.

92532-accept.name: Rorian the Dayseeker
92532-accept.text:
While you were gone our $c trainer--Blademaster Ren--requested that we send you their way when you returned. She dropped this note off for you as well.

Give it a read, then find Blademaster Ren inside the village watchtower.
92532-accept.title: The Warrior's Path

92532-progress.name: Blademaster Ren
92532-progress.text: So you've come for training, then?
92532-progress.title: The Warrior's Path
